notes: Page presents Lochinvar commercial condensing boiler systems and states the serial numbers shown are utilized with all Lochinvar brand systems; encoded from this page only, with no usesStylesOf and no sisters claimed (shared parent alone does not establish shared-system use). SHIPPED styles are those whose year (and week/month, where shipped) is stated in retrievable page text. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter) and page Style 7 (5Y013: month = 1st digit, year = 2nd letter) — both year/month codes live only in chart images, so no year can be encoded from text. Page Styles 3, 4, 5 and 6 ship YEAR-ONLY: their year digits are text-verified and only the month letter is chart-only, per the Cadet precedent. All shipped examples are the page's own example serials; expected values are derived from the page's stated positions, not page-stated worked decodes. Page-internal discrepancy noted: page Style 5 appears as 'J93-1030F' in the example list but as 'J93 12030F' in its section heading; COORDINATOR ADJUSTMENT encodes BOTH forms (combined pattern, same year positions, both decode to 1993) — see style-5 notes. The image pass may still confirm which form is canonical.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges.

Year = 1st and 2nd digits of the serial (normalized positions [1,3]); month = 1st letter, which is chart-only, so this style ships year-only. Page example shown as 'J-93 0001' in the section; normalized form used here.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter + 2 digits + letter + 8 digits (year only)
styles.notes: Year = 1st and 2nd digits (normalized positions [1,3]); month = 1st letter, which is chart-only, so this style ships year-only.

styles.era: 8- or 9-character serials, letter + 6 or 7 digits + letter (year only)
styles.notes: Year = 1st and 2nd digits (normalized positions [1,3]); month = 1st letter, which is chart-only, so this style ships year-only. COORDINATOR ADJUSTMENT (Wave 4 verification): the page presents TWO Style 5 example forms — list form 'J93-1030F' (8 chars) and section-heading form 'J93 12030F' (9 chars). Both are encoded: both decode to 1993 under the section's stated positions (2nd & 3rd digits), and the combined pattern is disjoint from every other Crest style (including held Styles 1 and 7 shapes), so covering both picks no winner and assumes no typo — if the section form is a page typo it never fires on real serials; if genuine it decodes correctly. The image pass may still confirm which form is canonical.
Year = 1st and 2nd digits (normalized positions [1,3]); month = 1st letter, which is chart-only, so this style ships year-only.

styles.era: 10-digit serials, year + month in last four digits
styles.notes: Page states the last four digits represent the year and month, in that order: year = 7th & 8th positions, month = 9th & 10th positions (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Same decode as the Cadet page's Style 8.
